title: Transfer receipt
description: Two account rows join into a single completed transfer receipt.
useCase: Connect the start and finish of a small local transaction preview.
interaction: Enter an amount, preview or cancel, and start again after completion.
reducedMotion: The account rows join immediately; status and controls retain the full flow.
limitations: A local timed preview. No financial accounts, funds movement or network requests.
look: Deep forest-green page with two pale sage account cards linked by a thin connector, monospace balances, an underlined amount field and a mint button.
motion: Submitting starts a 1.6 s pending timer; on completion the lower card slides up 12 px into the upper, corners square off and the connector scales away over 300 ms.
adapt: The join is CSS keyed on `data-done`: `.receipt[data-done=true] .account:last-child` gets `translateY(-12px)` and squared radii, `.join` gets `scaleY(0)`, with `.3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)` transitions. The `phase` timer (`1600` ms) stands in for a real transfer; replace accounts and amounts.
